Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Tehnologii energetice
Salesforce Senior ASSET Lead 
 SUMMARY OF THE ROLE 
 As part of the development and maintenance of second-generation Salesforce (2GP) packages, we are looking for a passionate and experienced developer who can design robust, modular, and reusable solutions integrated into 2GP packages, taking full advantage of Lightning Web Components (LWC) and Apex technologies. Experience on Agentforce would be a plus.
 KEY OBJECTIVES and KPI 
Design, develop, and maintain Salesforce 2GP packages.
Develop high-performance, responsive and maintainable LWC components.
Implement complex business logic in Apex (classes, triggers, batches, REST APIs).
Participate in the definition of the technical architecture of the packages.
Collaborate with functional teams to understand needs and translate them into technical solutions.
Ensure code quality through unit testing, code reviews, and continuous integration.
Manage package and release dependencies through Salesforce CLI and DevHub.
Participate in the continuous improvement of development practices within the Lab.
Agentforce layer and Einstein for developers.
 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 
Participate in the development and implementation of technical solutions on Salesforce in response to business needs.
Contribute to the design and development of 2GP packages, adhering to versioning and release management best practices.
Collaborate with functional and technical teams to ensure consistency of development and integration of solutions.
Participate in the management of package repositories and associated technical documentation.
Intervene during the code review, unit testing and continuous integration phases to ensure the quality of deliverables.
Support the teams during the deployment and support of solutions put into production.
 PROFILE – Academic background & Experience 
Seniority: Senior
Certifications: Salesforce Platform Developer II, Integration Architect
 BEHAVIOURAL CAPABILITIES 
Rigor and organizational skills to guarantee the quality and reliability of developments.
Ability to work in a team and collaborate effectively with a variety of profiles, both technical and functional.
Analytical and synthesis skills to understand needs, anticipate problems and propose appropriate solutions.
Autonomy and proactivity in task management and incident resolution.
Curiosity and willingness to stay informed of technological developments, especially in the Salesforce ecosystem.
Excellent communication skills, both written and oral, in both English and French languages.
Compliance with best practices and safety and performance standards.
 TECHNICAL Skills 
A perfect mastery of Salesforce DX and 2GP packaging is essential to ensure the quality of development and ensure effective management of versions and deployments.
Deep knowledge of Lightning Web Components (LWC), including composition, component communication, and lifecycle, enables you to design modern, high-performance user interfaces on the Salesforce platform.
Apex expertise, covering the creation of classes and triggers, the use of SOQL and SOSL queries, error handling, and unit testing, is essential to develop robust and scalable solutions.
Proven experience with release management tools such as Git and GitHub, as well as implementing continuous integration and deployment (CI/CD) processes, helps automate and ensure reliable deliveries.
Proficiency in Salesforce command-line interfaces, including SFDX CLI tools and scratch org environment management, makes it easy to develop, configure, and test Salesforce applications in a modern, automated framework.
Applying security and performance best practices on Salesforce is critical to ensuring compliance, data protection, and optimization of deployed solutions.
Knowledge of the COPADO release management tool is a plus.
 Languages 
English: B2/C1 minimum
French: B1-B2 is a great advantage
 Why Join Us? 
 Global Reach: Influence SLS strategy across continents and business units
 Technical Challenge: Work on a complex Salesforce Mono ORG / Multi Clouds and high-scale environment.
 Career Growth: Pathways to evolve in a worldwide Group
 Supportive Culture: Join a team that values innovation, transparency, and continuous learning
